paras: Chalcides delislei, also known commonly as Delisle's wedge-snouted skink, is a species of lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is native to northern Africa.
The specific name, delislei, is in honor of French anthropologist Fernand Delisle.
C. delislei is found in Algeria, Chad, Mali, Mauritania, Morocco, Niger, and Western Sahara.
The preferred natural habitats of C. delislei are desert and shrubland, at altitudes up to 700 m (2,300 ft).
C. delislei is diurnal, terrestrial, and fossorial.
C. delislei preys upon small beetles and their larvae.
